name: m3
comment: dt-cloud scan-run profile of m3's capture ingest (infra/aws/ingest.sh; SCAN_RUNS_PROFILE in Pulumi.rac.yaml). Runs are AWS Batch jobs: the run id is $AWS_BATCH_JOB_ID; ingest.sh states the job facts and passes its outputs (-o: the paths depend on the capture's store) and each run's store (-K). A run starts at its capture's start: the capture and queue phases bill nothing here. prices: Fargate ARM64 us-east-1 list, per vCPU ($0.03238/h) + per GiB ($0.00356/GiB-h) + ephemeral over the free 20 GiB ($0.000111/GiB-h): 1 vCPU / 8 GiB with 30 GiB ephemeral (until 2026-10-14), 2 vCPU / 16 GiB with 120 GiB (since 2026-10-15: the static name index's appends peak ~12 GiB); spot_factor approximates Fargate Spot's discount (it floats).
